label: German
source_guidance: Interpret German clause structure, case, grammatical gender and du/Sie. Distinguish grammatical forms from facts about characters.
target_guidance: Write idiomatic German literary prose: vary sentence structure (no English SVO monotone), prefer active constructions and German clause rhythm over calqued word order. Embellish flat source phrasing where German fiction conventions call for richer imagery — a plain English sentence may become an elegant German one, as long as no facts change. Keep case, verb placement, noun capitalization and relationship register in du/Sie consistent.
punctuation_rule: Follow German quotation, punctuation and spacing conventions. Preserve umlauts, ß and symbol pairing.
title_rule: Use conventional German titles and section labels, preserving noun capitalization.
